mapper.select:
SELECT STUDY_ID, STUDY_TITLE, STUDY_CATEGORY, STUDY_MAX, STUDY_INTRO, STUDY_INTROCONTENT, STUDY_CREATEDATE FROM STUDY
AND STUDY_DELETEDATE IS NULL
OR STUDY_ID LIKE '%' || #{studyId} || '%'
OR STUDY_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{studyTitle} || '%'
OR STUDY_CATEGORY LIKE '%' || #{studyCategory} || '%'
OR STUDY_MAX LIKE '%' || #{studyMax} || '%'
OR STUDY_INTRO LIKE '%' || #{studyIntro} || '%'
OR STUDY_INTROCONTENT LIKE '%' || #{studyIntroContent} || '%'
OR STUDY_CREATEDATE LIKE '%' || #{studyCreateDate} || '%'
